agent.goal: Edit the person's account: profile, password, notices, and removing the account.
when: The work is about the signed-in person, not the product.
avoid: Product name or invite policy — use Product settings.

agent.goal: Edit the person's account information inside Shell.
when: Profile, password, notices, and removing the account.
avoid: Product settings — use Product settings.

agent.goal: Jump between sections on the same page.
when: The page has named sections the person should jump between.
The sections stay on one scrollable surface.
avoid: Product area switching — use Shell navigation.
Parent path of the current page — use Breadcrumb.
Peer panels that replace each other — use Tabs.

agent.goal: Represent a person or entity with initials or an image.
when: Identity needs a compact face in lists, headers, or account chrome.
avoid: Using Avatar as a status badge — use Badge.
A product logo in Shell — use the product slot.

agent.goal: Show a compact status or category on a row or header.
when: A row or entity status that must stay scannable.
A short category next to a title.
avoid: A paragraph of feedback — use Message.
A page-wide notice — use Banner.
A button label — use Button.

agent.goal: Place a page-level note at the top of the work that stays until the condition ends or the person dismisses it.
when: A note about the whole page, not one field.
The note should stay until the condition ends, or until the person closes it.
avoid: A result next to the work that caused it — use Message.
A brief notice after leaving that work — use Toast.
A yes or no — use Dialog.

agent.goal: On a small screen, run a Dialog- or Drawer-like job from the foot.
when: The same job as Dialog or Drawer, on a small screen, from the foot.
avoid: Desktop full-height tasks — use Drawer.
A control-attached menu — use Popover or Dropdown.

agent.goal: Show the path inside the current area with the current page strongest.
when: Quiet ancestors, then the current page.
Depth is more than one level inside an area.
avoid: A second product menu in the header.
Same-page section jumps — use Anchor.
Switching product domains — use Menu in Shell.

agent.goal: Pick a button variant from how primary the action is, not from color taste.
avoid: Multiple primary buttons in one region.
Using danger for ordinary navigation.

cases.name: Primary
cases.when: The one main action in the region.

cases.name: Secondary
cases.when: A supporting action beside the primary.

cases.name: Ghost
cases.when: A quiet action in a dense tool chrome.

cases.name: Danger
cases.when: A destructive confirm the person must notice.

cases.name: Disabled
cases.when: The action is unavailable and should stay visible.

cases.name: Wide / Dense
cases.when: Layout needs full width or tighter padding.

agent.goal: Present a self-contained scannable unit among peers.
when: The block should read as one unit in a set of peers.
A metric, person, or next step that stands alone in a grid or row.
avoid: A full page region — use Panel.
Decorating every stack with a card when space alone is enough.
Form chrome — use Fieldset or Form group.

decisions.title: Card vs Panel
decisions.choose: Card for peer units in a set.
decisions.insteadOf: Panel for a full page region.

agent.goal: Toggle one independent yes/no, or select several options.
when: An independent on/off fact.
Several options may be true at once.
avoid: Exactly one of a small set — use Radio.
A settings switch with immediate effect — use Switch.
A closed list that should collapse — use Select.

agent.goal: Use catalog color tokens. Prefer semantic tokens in product UI; primitives are the ramp underneath.
when: Need fill, text, border, or status color from the system.
avoid: Hard-coded hex in product UI.
Inventing a new status color outside the catalog.

agent.goal: Pick a content container from how the block relates to the page — not from decoration.
avoid: Wrapping every block in a Card when a Panel or bare Stack is enough.
Using Empty state outside the empty container.

cases.name: Panel
cases.when: A region of the page that holds related work.

cases.name: Card
cases.when: A self-contained unit the person can scan among peers.

cases.name: Empty
cases.when: The container has no items yet.

cases.name: Metrics
cases.when: A few key numbers with optional trend.

cases.name: Key-value
cases.when: Labeled facts for one record.

cases.name: Article row / grid
cases.when: Editorial cards in a row or grid.

agent.goal: Create one object inside Shell. Use a wizard only when a later answer depends on an earlier one.
when: Make one object.
Fields belong to the new record.
Save and Cancel sit at the end of one form.
avoid: Editing an existing record — use Modifying a record.
A single fact where it sits — use Inline edit.
A later answer depends on an earlier one — use Wizard.

decisions.title: Flat form vs wizard
decisions.choose: Create a record when every field can sit on one page.

agent.goal: Show labeled facts for one record as term/description pairs.
when: Read-only key facts for one object.
Detail views that pair a label with a value.
avoid: Editable fields — use a form.
Many records — use a table.
Grouped sections with titles — use Detail group.

agent.goal: Present one record for reading, split into groups, tabs, or steps as the content needs.
when: The person is reading one record, and the content is one level. Groups split the facts.
The parts are weakly related, such as profile, access, and activity — use tabs.
The record has a process — use steps, and put the decision with the record.
avoid: Many records of the same kind — use a table.
The person is changing the record — use a form.

agent.goal: Split a read-only record into named groups of facts.
when: One record, several weakly separated fact groups.
avoid: Editing those facts — use a form.
Ordered process stages — use Steps.

agent.goal: Stop the page for a confirm or a short form (one or two fields).
when: The page must wait.
Confirm a destructive action, or rename with one or two fields.
avoid: A full-height task while keeping the page — use Drawer.
A quick non-blocking task — use Slide-in or Popover.
A small screen foot sheet for the same job — use Bottom sheet.
A brief result after leaving the work — use Toast.

agent.goal: Separate regions with a quiet rule, not a card boundary.
when: Two regions need a visual break without becoming separate cards.
avoid: Wrapping every block in a Card just to separate them.

agent.goal: Keep the page visible and run a full-height task beside it.
when: The task needs the full height.
The person will compare the panel with the page for a while.
avoid: A yes or no — use Dialog.
A quick task that should not take the full height — use Slide-in.
A small panel on one control — use Popover.

agent.goal: Offer a list of actions from one control.
when: A list of actions only.
Secondary commands that should stay out of the primary bar.
avoid: A small task panel with fields — use Popover.
Primary navigation — use Menu or Shell.
Choosing one value for a form — use Select.

agent.goal: Say the container is empty after a successful load. Put it inside the region that is empty.
when: The region loaded successfully and has nothing to show.
There is one clear next step, or a short explanation when no action fits.
avoid: Still waiting on data — use Loader.
An empty table with no sentence — set Table empty copy.
A failed load — use Message or Table error, not Empty state.
A field error — use Field.
Feedback about a finished action — use Message or Toast.

decisions.title: Action or not
decisions.choose: Include an action when the person can create or invite from here.
decisions.insteadOf: A decorative empty block with no path forward when one exists.

decisions.title: Empty vs loading
decisions.choose: Empty state only after a successful load with no items.
decisions.insteadOf: Empty copy while the request is still in flight.

agent.goal: Reveal a few more facts on the same card without leaving the page.
when: A few more facts belong on the same card.
The title and status should stay put while the body grows.
avoid: A new page of fields — use a record pattern.
A table row expand — that expand is separate from this region.

agent.goal: Bind a control to a label, help, and error that stay with the field.
when: A custom control needs the same label, hint, and error chrome as Text field.
You are composing layout around a control the catalog does not wrap yet.
avoid: A single-line text value — use Text field.
A known list of options — use Select or Radio.
Page-level results — use Message or Banner.

decisions.title: Wrapped control vs Field shell
decisions.choose: Prefer Text field, Select, and siblings that already wrap Field.
decisions.insteadOf: Rebuilding Field chrome around those controls by hand.

agent.goal: Group related fields under one legend inside a form.
when: Several fields share one meaning and should be named together.
avoid: A single field — use Field alone.
Page sections that are not a form — use detail groups or tabs.

agent.goal: Lay out items on one line with shared alignment.
when: Items stay on one line.
avoid: Inline items should wrap — use Space.
Blocks stack vertically — use Stack.

agent.goal: Own submit lifecycle for a set of fields.
when: Creating or changing a record with an explicit submit.
avoid: Read-only display — use Detail.
One in-place fact — use Inline edit.

agent.goal: Create or change one record with fields that belong to that record.
when: The person is creating a record, or changing one.
The fields belong to that one record.
avoid: The person is reading the record — use a detail.
Many records of the same kind — use a table.

agent.goal: Pick one Layout frame from how people move. A product keeps one primary frame; a public page may use another.
when: Few destinations → header, content, footer.
Global bar + section menu → header, then side.
Many areas, used often → side, then header.
One tool → side and content.
avoid: Two equal product menus (side and top bar).
A header that only repeats the page title.
A full-height side on a public page with a handful of links.

cases.name: Side, then header
cases.when: People return often and switch areas from a stable product menu. The header names the current area and holds that area's actions.
cases.use: Layout with sider + header, siderPlacement full-height. Side = product menu. Header = area path/actions. Content = the work.
cases.avoid: Do not repeat the product menu in the header. Do not use a full-height side for a public page with a handful of links.

cases.name: Header, content, footer
cases.when: The page is read top to bottom and first-level links fit in one bar (marketing, simple home, stable-width document).
cases.use: Layout with header + footer + content. Top bar = product name and short links. Footer = secondary links only.
cases.avoid: Skip when the section menu is long or people switch areas all day — a top bar runs out of room.

cases.name: Header, then side
cases.when: Docs, settings, or help: people arrive from the product, then move within one section.
cases.use: Layout with header + sider. Top bar stays global. Side is the section menu.
cases.avoid: Do not put the product menu in the side and again in the header. Do not use this when switching areas is the main job.

cases.name: Side and content
cases.when: A focused tool — canvas, editor, or a list that is the whole job.
cases.use: Layout with sider + content only. Side = structure of the work (files, layers, sections).
cases.avoid: Do not add a header only to repeat the page title. Do not use for a public site that needs a brand bar and legal links.

decisions.title: Where is the product menu?
decisions.choose: Either the side or the top bar — one product menu.
decisions.insteadOf: Duplicating the same destinations in both places.

decisions.title: What does the header own?
decisions.choose: In an app frame, the current area: path, area actions, invite.

decisions.title: Public page vs app shell
decisions.choose: Public/read pages lean header+footer; apps lean full-height side.
decisions.insteadOf: Forcing one frame on every surface.

agent.goal: Orient a human or agent to how this catalog is organized before building screens.
when: Starting work in the catalog or choosing where a screen belongs.
avoid: Skipping Patterns/Overview when the job is a workflow.
Building product chrome outside Shell.

decisions.title: Where does a new screen start?
decisions.choose: Try it as a catalog story first; hold workspaces/clients/projects in the app only when asked.
decisions.insteadOf: Jumping straight into a one-off page without a pattern.

agent.goal: Place equal columns of the same kind of block.
when: Equal columns of the same kind of block.
avoid: Uneven blocks that pack — use Masonry.
Two resizable panes — use Splitter.

agent.goal: Edit one fact where it already sits without opening a full form. Keep Shell as the frame.
when: One fact changes in place.
The change commits from the field.
avoid: Several related fields at once — use Modifying a record.

agent.goal: Show that content is still loading without implying emptiness.
when: Waiting on a response for a region or table rows.
The shape of the result is known enough to reserve space.
avoid: No items after a successful load — use Empty state.
A finished error — use Message or Table error.
A brief notice after leaving the work — use Toast.

cases.name: Record
cases.when: A person or a row is coming.

cases.name: Text
cases.when: A paragraph is coming.

cases.name: Media
cases.when: A card with a picture is coming.

cases.name: Circle
cases.when: A compact indeterminate wait.

agent.goal: Pack uneven blocks into columns instead of one aligned row.
when: Blocks are uneven.
They should pack into columns instead of lining up on one row.
avoid: Equal columns of the same kind of block — use Grid.
Two resizable panes — use Splitter.

agent.goal: Present a structured set of destinations or commands in a menu surface.
when: A structured menu of destinations or commands.
Shell side navigation that changes the page while chrome stays.
avoid: A single row of actions from one button — use Dropdown.
Section jumps on one page — use Anchor.
Weakly related peer panels — use Tabs.

decisions.title: Destinations vs actions
decisions.choose: Menu for destinations with a current value.
decisions.insteadOf: Dropdown for a short action list from one button.

agent.goal: Show a result next to the work that caused it. The page stays usable.
when: A note about something that just happened, next to that work.
Settings, account, and other modules use Message for a saved or removed result.
avoid: An empty container — use Empty state inside the panel.
A field that failed — use Field; the error sits with the field.
A row status — use Badge.
A table that failed to load — use Table error; the header stays.
A note about the whole page — use Banner.
A brief notice after leaving the work — use Toast.

decisions.title: Still on the work vs left the work
decisions.choose: Message next to the work while the person is still there.
decisions.insteadOf: Toast over the page for an in-place result.

decisions.title: Page-wide vs local
decisions.choose: Banner for a note about the whole page that should stay.
decisions.insteadOf: Message when the note is not tied to one local action.

agent.goal: Change one existing object in a focused form or detail flow inside Shell.
when: Change one object.
Edit opens the form from the detail; Save returns to the detail.
avoid: One fact edited where it sits — use Inline edit.
Creating a new object — use Create a record.

agent.goal: Use catalog motion tokens. Prefer semantic tokens in product UI; primitives are the ramp underneath.
when: Need enter, leave, or feedback motion from the catalog recipes.
avoid: Custom springs that fight reduced-motion and catalog recipes.

agent.goal: Apply a named motion recipe (reveal, fade, leave, feedback) instead of inventing timing.
when: An overlay, toast, or expandable needs enter/leave motion.
avoid: Per-component bespoke easing when a recipe already fits.

agent.goal: Move to another part of the product while Shell stays.
when: Another part of the product.
avoid: Switching organization — use Switching organizations.

agent.goal: Run first-run setup: name the workspace and offer one invite.
when: First run.
avoid: Everyday product settings after setup — use Product settings.

agent.goal: Pick one overlay job. Do not nest overlays. Message, Toast, and Banner are not overlays.
avoid: Opening a dialog, drawer, slide-in, bottom sheet, or popover from another overlay — close the first one.
A tooltip may sit on a control inside an overlay; that is the only nesting allowed.

cases.name: Dialog
cases.when: The page must wait. Confirm, or one or two fields.

cases.name: Drawer
cases.when: Keep the page. The task needs the full height.

cases.name: Slide-in
cases.when: Keep the page. A quick task that should not take the full height.

cases.name: Bottom sheet
cases.when: The same job as Dialog or Drawer, on a small screen, from the foot.

cases.name: Popover
cases.when: A small panel attached to a control. The page stays live.

cases.name: Tooltip
cases.when: A short hint. No actions.

cases.name: Message
cases.when: A result next to the work.
cases.avoid: Do not treat Message as an overlay.

cases.name: Toast
cases.when: A brief notice after leaving the work.

cases.name: Banner
cases.when: A note about the whole page that should stay.

agent.goal: Page through a long set when virtualization is not the product choice.
when: Too many parents to show at once and the product prefers pages.
The person needs a stable page address for a slice of the list.
avoid: Short lists — omit pagination.
Steady-height infinite scroll preference — consider Table virtualize.
Filtering that shrinks the set — show Empty state when nothing matches.

agent.goal: Pick a workflow pattern by job, then copy that story. Keep Shell as the frame.
avoid: Treating patterns as package exports — they are compositions to copy.
Dropping Shell when copying a pattern into the app.

cases.name: Navigating domains
cases.when: Another part of the product.
cases.use: Shell stays; the page inside changes.

cases.name: Switching organizations
cases.when: Another organization.
cases.use: Pick it in the product slot. The domain menu stays.

cases.name: Product settings
cases.when: The product's settings.
cases.use: Name, who can invite, and removing the product. The domain menu stays.

cases.name: Account information
cases.when: The person's account.
cases.use: Profile, password, notices, and removing the account.

cases.name: Create a record
cases.when: Make one object.
cases.use: Create a record. Use a wizard when a later answer depends on an earlier one.

cases.name: Modifying a record
cases.when: Change one object.
cases.use: Modifying a record. Inline edit is for one fact where it sits.

cases.name: Onboarding
cases.when: First run.
cases.use: Name the workspace and offer one invite.

cases.name: Task management
cases.when: A queue.
cases.use: Status first, then the record or why it cannot continue.

cases.name: Visualization page
cases.when: A set of numbers.
cases.use: Summary first. It stays its own page until there is a chart module.

cases.name: Planning
cases.when: A path and the work it implies.
cases.use: A journey names friction. A story map slices the first release.

agent.goal: Reserve space for content that is not ready yet without implying an empty collection.
when: Layout needs a stand-in while media or copy loads.
avoid: No items in a list or panel — use Empty state.
A failed request — use Message or Table error.

agent.goal: Name friction on a journey and slice the first release on a story map.
when: A path and the work it implies.
avoid: Treating planning boards as day-to-day task queues — use Task management for queues.

agent.goal: Attach a small live panel to one control without stopping the page.
when: A small task that belongs to one control.
The person should still use the page behind it.
avoid: The page must wait — use Dialog, or Bottom sheet on a small screen.
The task needs the full height — use Drawer.
A short hint with no actions — use Tooltip.
A list of actions only — use Dropdown.

agent.goal: Edit the product's settings without losing the domain menu.
when: Name, who can invite, and removing the product.
avoid: Account profile work — use Account information.

agent.goal: Choose exactly one option from a small visible set.
when: Few options that should stay on screen.
Exactly one must be selected.
avoid: A long list of options — use Select.
Independent toggles — use Checkbox.
An immediate on/off setting — use Switch.

agent.goal: Use catalog radius tokens. Prefer semantic tokens in product UI; primitives are the ramp underneath.
when: Need corner radius on a surface or control.
avoid: Mixing many radii in one region without a reason.

agent.goal: Choose one option from a known list that does not need to stay fully visible.
when: A closed set of options that does not need to stay fully visible.
The list is longer than a few choices, or the page is dense.
avoid: Few options that should stay visible — use Radio.
Multiple independent toggles — use Checkbox.
A setting that takes effect immediately — use Switch.
Free text — use Text field or Text area.

decisions.title: Visible peers vs collapsed list
decisions.choose: Radio when a few options should stay on screen.
decisions.insteadOf: Select when the person needs to compare short peers at a glance.

agent.goal: Edit product settings inside Shell without inventing a second product menu.
when: Name, invite policy, and removing the product.
avoid: Putting account profile fields here — use Account information.
Hiding the domain menu while editing product settings.

agent.goal: Use catalog shadow tokens. Prefer semantic tokens in product UI; primitives are the ramp underneath.
when: Need elevation for an overlay or raised surface.
avoid: Stacking shadows for decoration on flat content.

agent.goal: Keep Shell as the product frame: navigation, settings, help, and account stay while page content changes.
when: Building any app page that lives inside the product chrome.
avoid: Replacing Shell with a one-off header for ordinary product pages.
Duplicating product navigation inside page content.

decisions.title: Where does area content go?
decisions.choose: Inside Shell's content region for the current area.
decisions.insteadOf: Rebuilding navigation, settings, help, or account around the page.

agent.goal: Use catalog sizing tokens. Prefer semantic tokens in product UI; primitives are the ramp underneath.
when: Need control height, icon box, or fixed width from the scale.
avoid: Ad-hoc widths that fight the sizing scale.

agent.goal: Keep the page and open a short edge panel that does not take the full height.
when: A quick task on the current page.
The panel should not take the full height.
avoid: The task needs the full height, or the person will compare it with the list for a while — use Drawer.
A yes or no — use Dialog.
A small screen, from the foot — use Bottom sheet.
A small panel attached to a control — use Popover.

agent.goal: Lay out inline items that may wrap onto the next line.
when: Inline items should wrap onto the next line.
A row of actions that may not fit.
avoid: Items stay on one line — use Flex.
Blocks stack vertically — use Stack.

agent.goal: Use catalog spacing tokens. Prefer semantic tokens in product UI; primitives are the ramp underneath.
when: Need padding, gap, or margin between elements.
avoid: Arbitrary pixel spacing in product layouts.

agent.goal: Split the view into two resizable panes.
when: A list beside its details.
The person should be able to resize the two panes.
avoid: Equal columns of the same kind of block — use Grid.
Uneven blocks that pack — use Masonry.

agent.goal: Stack blocks vertically with the parent owning the gap.
when: Blocks sit one under another.
The parent owns the gap. The children do not add their own margin.
avoid: Items stay on one line — use Flex.
Inline items should wrap — use Space.

agent.goal: Show a linear process on one record with the decision beside the work.
when: The record has a process with ordered stages.
The person should see progress without leaving the page.
avoid: Weakly related sections with no order — use Tabs.
A multi-page create flow — use Wizard.
Top-level product areas — use Shell navigation.

agent.goal: Toggle an immediate setting on or off.
when: A setting that takes effect now.
The person should see on versus off without opening a menu.
avoid: A form fact submitted later — use Checkbox.
Choosing among more than two values — use Radio or Select.
A destructive confirm — use Dialog.

decisions.title: Immediate setting vs form fact
decisions.choose: Switch when the change takes effect now.
decisions.insteadOf: Checkbox for a fact that only matters on submit.

agent.goal: Switch organization from the product slot while the domain menu stays.
when: Another organization.
avoid: Navigating to another domain page — use Navigating domains.

agent.goal: Open extra fields under a row without inventing new columns.
when: expandable opens a panel under the row with renderDetail. Use it for extra fields, not new columns. expansion controls how many panels stay open. renderCell handles custom column kinds.
avoid: Do not edit cells inline or add date, number, or combobox inputs in the table. Changing a record belongs in the modifying-record pattern or a detail view.

agent.goal: Add find tools when the person must search, filter, sort, or choose visible columns.
when: Search, status filter, sort, or column visibility is part of the task.
avoid: Do not enable every find control by default on a short fixed list.

agent.goal: Handle too many rows with virtualization or paging.
when: virtualize is for long lists with steady row height. pageSize and pageSizeOptions slice parents and compose Pagination when you prefer pages over scrolling.
avoid: Do not virtualize short lists or rows whose height changes a lot from expanded panels.

agent.goal: Render a basic selectable member table without extra toolbar power.
when: Pass id, name, status, statusVariant on each item; put other fields in values and links in hrefs. Wire selection with value, defaultValue, and onValueChange.
avoid: Do not turn on search, filters, bulk actions, or virtualization until the workflow needs them.

agent.goal: Show many records of the same kind, one row each. Start with Members; open another story only when the task needs that behavior.
when: The records share the same fields, and the person is looking for one of them.
The person compares a value down a column, such as a status or a date.
avoid: The row is a summary — use a list.
Each record stands on its own and order does not matter — use cards.
The person is changing the record — use modifying a record; cells stay read-only.
Column resize, reorder, extra pinned columns, and spreadsheet editing wait until a workflow needs them.

cases.name: Members
cases.when: You need the records only: name, fields, status, and selecting a row.

cases.name: Find
cases.when: You need search, a status filter, sort, or a choice of which columns stay in view.

cases.name: Select and act
cases.when: You need to choose several records and run an action.

cases.name: Expand
cases.when: You need more about one record, under its row.

cases.name: States
cases.when: You need loading, a failed load, an empty list, or a change in row density.

cases.name: Wide and sticky
cases.when: You have many columns, and the header and the name should stay put.

cases.name: Long list
cases.when: You have too many rows to show at once.

agent.goal: Let the person select several rows and run a bulk action.
when: Multiple records must be chosen, then one shared action runs.
avoid: Do not stack expand, virtualization, and every toolbar flag on one screen unless the task truly needs it.

agent.goal: Represent loading, error, empty, and density as explicit table states.
when: loading shows Loader rows. error keeps the header and shows a message. empty is copy when there are no items. A search or filter with no hits uses built-in no matches copy. density changes row padding.
avoid: Do not show an empty table with no sentence. Set disabled on an item so it stays visible but cannot be selected.

agent.goal: Keep orientation on wide grids with sticky header and a pinned name column.
when: stickyHeader keeps the header in the scroll frame. stickyColumn pins the name column when many columns scroll sideways. Use both together on wide grids.
avoid: Do not pin columns that are not the primary identifier.

agent.goal: Switch weakly related parts of one record or view without leaving the page.
when: Parts are weakly related, such as profile, access, and activity.
The person should see which tab is current while the mark moves.
avoid: A linear process — use Steps.
Top-level product areas — use Shell navigation.
A route change — use the shell.

decisions.title: Peers vs ordered stages
decisions.choose: Tabs for weakly related peer panels.
decisions.insteadOf: Steps when the work has a required order.

agent.goal: Present a queue inside Shell with status first, then the record or why it cannot continue.
when: A queue of work items.
A blocked item must explain why, not look like an empty detail.
avoid: A plain member directory with no workflow status — use Table Members.
One record with no list beside it — use a detail.

agent.goal: Collect multi-line text. Pair with Field for label, help, and error.
when: Notes, descriptions, or other multi-line copy.
The person may write more than one sentence.
avoid: A single short value — use Text field.
A choice from options — use Select or Radio.

agent.goal: Collect a single line of text. Pair with Field for label, help, and error.
when: One short value: name, email, title, slug.
The answer is typed, not chosen from a list.
avoid: Long prose — use Text area.
A choice from options — use Select, Radio, or Checkbox.
An immediate on/off setting — use Switch.

decisions.title: Typed value vs choice
decisions.choose: Text field when the person invents the string.
decisions.insteadOf: Select or Radio when the options are already known.

agent.goal: Read the full semantic theme (color, type, space, radius) before inventing visual values.
when: Starting a visual change and you need the live token sheet.
Checking light/dark semantic swaps without opening every foundation story.
avoid: Hard-coded hex, rem, or px for theme values in product UI.
Editing primitive ramps for a one-off product tint — retarget semantic tokens instead.

agent.goal: Show a brief notice after the person has left the work. The page stays usable.
when: A brief result after the person has left the work.
The page should stay usable.
avoid: A result next to the work that caused it — use Message.
A page-level note that should stay — use Banner.
A yes or no, or a short form the page must wait for — use Dialog.

decisions.title: Placement
decisions.choose: Bottom of the screen, or top right — pick one placement for the product.
decisions.insteadOf: Mixing placements without a product rule.

agent.goal: Show a short non-interactive hint on hover or focus.
when: A short hint that is not required to finish the task.
Hover or focus is enough. There is nothing to click inside it.
avoid: A control, a field, or a link inside the hint — use Popover.
A result of an action — use Message, or Toast after leaving the work.
A yes or no — use Dialog.

agent.goal: Use catalog type tokens. Prefer semantic tokens in product UI; primitives are the ramp underneath.
when: Need a text role: display, title, body, label, or mono.
avoid: One-off font sizes outside the type scale.
Using display type for dense app chrome.

agent.goal: Show a set of numbers with summary first on its own page inside Shell.
when: A set of numbers. Summary first.
Decision makers need the whole picture, and a way to open one number for more.
avoid: A list of records — use a table.
One object's facts — use a detail.
Waiting for a chart module before shipping a summary page — keep it its own page until then.

agent.goal: Step through creation inside Shell when later answers depend on earlier ones.
when: A later answer depends on an earlier one.
The person should not see the whole form at once.
avoid: A flat form with independent fields — use Create a record.
First run of the product — use Onboarding.
